# and shisha OKINAWA

> The only shisha (hookah) specialty café in Onna Village, Okinawa, Japan. A calm, refined café space where you can smoke shisha, or just have coffee and dessert. English-speaking staff. Beginner friendly.
> 沖縄・恩納村で唯一のシーシャ（水タバコ）専門カフェ。落ち着いたカフェ空間。英語対応スタッフ在籍。初心者歓迎。

## Key facts

- **Name**: and shisha OKINAWA （アンドシーシャ オキナワ）
- **Type**: Shisha / hookah lounge and café (シーシャカフェ)
- **Location**: Maeganeku 54-1, 2F, Onna Village, Kunigami District, Okinawa 904-0414, Japan (〒904-0414 沖縄県国頭郡恩納村前兼久54-1 2F) — on the west-coast resort strip, an easy drive from Kadena, Torii Station and Camp Hansen
- **Hours**: 2:00 PM – 1:00 AM (14:00–25:00). Closed Mondays.
- **Languages**: English and Japanese. English-speaking staff are on site.
- **Payment**: Cash, credit cards, QR code / electronic money. Currency: JPY.
- **Age policy**: Shisha is for guests aged 20 and over (Japanese law). ID may be requested.
- **Reservations**: Walk-ins welcome.
- **Website**: https://and-shisha-okinawa.search-mania.net/ (Japanese) / https://and-shisha-okinawa.search-mania.net/en/ (English)
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/and_shisha.okinawa/

## What makes it distinctive

- The only shisha specialty shop in Onna Village.
- 50–60 shisha flavors, with DOZAJ as the main flavor line.
- Nicotine-free shisha is available, making it approachable for first-timers and non-smokers.
- Desserts made with Okinawa-grown ingredients, plus coffee and soft drinks.
- Café-only visits are welcome — you do not have to smoke shisha to come in.
- The room is calm enough for meetings, interviews or laptop work.

## Who it suits

Travellers driving Okinawa's west coast, people with time to kill before hotel check-in or a bus, anyone winding down after a beach or dive day, US visitors and English-speaking residents of Okinawa, first-time shisha smokers, and people who want a quiet café that happens to serve shisha.

Prices shown on the site are a guide in Japanese yen. The exact street address and phone number are being finalised; please use Google Maps or Instagram for the most current details.
